name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A month grid for choosing a day, several days or a range of days, with days that can be unavailable for a stated reason and days that carry a mark. Days are plain "YYYY-MM-DD" strings, so no time zone can move them.

meta.when: Choosing dates where seeing the month matters: a booking, a stay, a deadline. It stays on the page; to open it from a field use date-picker. Never use the browser's native date input beside it. For a date far in the past that the person knows by heart (a birthday) three plain fields are quicker. Pass `locale` (the page's language) so that names, numerals and the first day of the week are right; without it the calendar is in English.
